profile.reasoning: Mikael Bianchi is a 38-year-old founder and CEO of 'Synapse Core,' a company building a distributed, serverless compute platform specifically designed for AI inference at the edge. He previously spent 8 years at AWS, deeply involved in the early development of Lambda and key infrastructure components. A distinctive detail is that he *left* AWS after becoming frustrated with the limitations of existing cloud infrastructure for real-time AI applications – specifically latency and cost. He’s currently focused on securing a Series B funding round to expand Synapse Core’s engineering team and scale its platform. He's very technically hands-on, still contributing to the core codebase, and prioritizes engineering excellence above all else. He’s seeking connections to VCs specializing in infrastructure and AI, potential key hires (especially in Rust and distributed systems), and strategic partners who can help with edge deployment. He's somewhat skeptical of 'hype' in the AI space and values demonstrable results and technical depth.
profile.positioning: I founded Synapse Core to solve a fundamental bottleneck in the AI revolution: efficient and cost-effective inference at the edge. Existing cloud solutions simply aren’t optimized for the demands of real-time AI applications, particularly regarding latency and cost. We’re building a serverless compute platform, leveraging a novel distributed architecture, that brings the power of cloud computing directly to the edge device.  My background at AWS, where I was a core contributor to Lambda’s initial development, gave me a unique insight into the challenges and opportunities in this space.  At Synapse Core, we’ve already achieved significant traction with early adopters in the robotics and autonomous vehicle sectors, demonstrating a 70% reduction in inference costs and a 5x improvement in latency compared to traditional cloud deployments. We are focused on building the foundational infrastructure to power the next generation of intelligent applications, and I’m passionate about partnering with individuals and organizations who share that vision.
